hooks.command: codeflow hook git-guard --contract 3; codeflow_status=$?; if [ "$codeflow_status" -ne 0 ]; then codeflow_ok=; if command -v codeflow >/dev/null 2>&1 && codeflow_probe=$(mktemp "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/codeflow-probe.XXXXXX" 2>/dev/null); then (codeflow git-hook capabilities </dev/null 2>/dev/null & echo "pid $!"; wait "$!"; echo "rc $?") >"$codeflow_probe" 2>/dev/null & codeflow_pid=$!; codeflow_wait=20; while [ "$codeflow_wait" -gt 0 ] && ! grep -q '^rc ' "$codeflow_probe"; do sleep 0.1 2>/dev/null || sleep 1; codeflow_wait=$((codeflow_wait - 1)); done; if grep -qx 'rc 0' "$codeflow_probe" && grep -qx 'hooks 3' "$codeflow_probe"; then codeflow_ok=1; elif ! grep -q '^rc ' "$codeflow_probe"; then kill -9 $(sed -n 's/^pid //p' "$codeflow_probe") "$codeflow_pid" 2>/dev/null; fi; wait "$codeflow_pid" 2>/dev/null; rm -f "$codeflow_probe"; fi; if [ -z "$codeflow_ok" ]; then echo "codeflow: hook binary missing or older; install with: curl -fsSL https://github.com/sathyassn/codeflow/releases/latest/download/codeflow-cli-installer.sh | sh ; then run codeflow update" >&2; fi; exit 2; fi
